items.quote: 8 out of 10 new agents leave the company
items.statement: 8 out of 10 new agents leave the company in the first few months.

items.quote: I still don’t fully understand what I should physically do
items.statement: New agents often express confusion about daily actions required to earn money.

items.quote: move every new agent from learning to earning as fast as possible
items.statement: Focus onboarding on practical daily actions and specific sales processes.

items.quote: They lack clarity on daily actions, on sales processes, on what enough looks like.
items.statement: Agents report a lack of clarity on what is sufficient activity to make commissions.

items.quote: It would help to have practical Q&A sessions with agents
items.statement: Incorporate practical Q&A sessions with successful agents in training programs.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing reasons for high turnover among new agents and improving onboarding processes.
